0811Crop and livestock production

Greenhouse Climate Control Environment

Space · HemantPurswani/Trident_Titans

Set heater, ventilation, humidifier and lighting levels each hour to keep a greenhouse in range, grow crops and save energy over up to 7 days.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • long-horizon control
  • continuous action control by LLMs

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Dense, per step

Per-step multi-objective reward in [0,1] from temperature, humidity, light, CO2, energy and stability scores; task graders score 0-1.

2. Run the Space locallyevery Space is a Docker image or app you can clone

cd Trident_Titans
